page.overview:
What is Bloody Baron?

The Bloody Baron (d. 11th century) was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the Founders' time and was Sorted into Slytherin House.

After Hogwarts, he fell in love with Helena Ravenclaw, but she did not love him in return. He was sent by Rowena Ravenclaw to find Helena in Albania, but Helena refused to return with him and so he killed her in a rage. When he realised what he had done, the Baron committed suicide with the same knife.

After his death, he became one of the ghosts that haunts Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, and the house ghost of Slytherin House. Covered in Helena Ravenclaw's blood to this day, he earned himself the moniker of "Bloody Baron".

The Baron was born into nobility, no earlier than 982.
